context: Left over from the Sphinx cleanup in #3844, whose PR body expected a CI refresh to drop the entries; no automated refresh rewrites this file.
description: tests/fixtures/medium_shard_durations.json still lists three test_sphinx_* tests that #3844 deleted with the Sphinx template adapter. Nothing removes entries like these: fast-duration-baseline-refresh.yml commits only tests/fixtures/fast_tier_baseline, and for medium durations it runs medium-drift, whose report (scripts/build_fast_duration_baseline.py:309-343) looks only at measured tests and recommends a refresh only on timing skew. The last medium refresh was a manual PR (#3538, 2026-10-26). The entries are inert for sharding but accumulate as tests are deleted.
